20644:         const a=await window.caseflowLocalAnalyze(src.dataUrl, src.category||null);

20703:   async function regenerate(){
20704:     if(regenBusy){ regenQueued=true; return; }
20705:     const src=state._simSource||pickSource();
20706:     if(!src) return;
20707:     regenBusy=true; setBusy(true);
20708:     try{
20709:       const url=await produceImage(src);
20710:       // Slider edits UPDATE the currently selected gallery slot in place (other variations
20711:       // stay intact), so re-editing never makes a previously generated image disappear.
20712:       const r=Object.assign({}, state.simResult, {
20713:         dataUrl:url, source:src.dataUrl, srcObj:src, sourceKind:sourceKind(src),
20714:         createdAt:new Date().toISOString(), settings:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state.simV96))
20715:       });
20716:       if(Array.isArray(state.simResults) && state.simResults.length){ state.simResults[state.simResultIndex||0]=r; }
20717:       else { state.simResults=[r]; state.simResultIndex=0; }
20718:       state.simResult=r;
20719:       cfAutoSaveTempSim(r);   // ① keep the 48h temp Library copy in sync with slider edits
20720:       renderResultImages();
20721:       // Persist the new result immediately so a reload won't lose it
20722:       try{ if(window.cfPersist) cfPersist.schedule(1000); }catch(e){}
20723:     }catch(e){ console.error(e); toastFn('再生成に失敗しました'); }
20724:     regenBusy=false; setBusy(false);
20725:     if(regenQueued){ regenQueued=false; regenerate(); }
20726:   }

19651:   // Pixel-level Bio-Blend overlay for intraoral contraster shots. BIDIRECTIONAL:
19652:   //   bb > 0 => naturalization microstructure: マメロン / 周波条 / ハロー効果
19653:   //   bb < 0 => SMOOTH: minimise surface texture / anatomy, emphasise a smooth even surface
19654:   // ox = 2d context of the source image (used to build the enamel mask).
19655:   // ctx = output 2d context to draw effects onto.
19656:   // bb = signed bio-blend strength, -1..+1.
19657:   function applyIntraoralBioBlend(ctx, ox, w, h, bb){
19658:     if(Math.abs(bb) <= 0.01) return;
19659:     const smooth = bb < 0;
19660:     const amt = Math.abs(bb);   // 0..1
19661:     const em = enamelMaskCanvas(ox, w, h);
19662:     if(!em) return;
19663:     const emx = em.getContext('2d', {willReadFrequently: true});
19664:     const emD = emx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data;
19665:     let id; try{ id = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h); } catch(e){ return; }
19666:     const d = id.data;
19667:     // For the SMOOTH side we blend each enamel pixel toward a blurred copy of itself, which
19668:     // evens out perikymata / mammellons / micro-texture and emphasises a smooth surface.
19669:     let blurD=null;
19670:     if(smooth){
19671:       try{
19672:         const bc=document.createElement('canvas'); bc.width=w; bc.height=h;
19673:         const bx=bc.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
19674:         bx.filter='blur('+Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.min(w,h)*0.004*(0.5+amt)))+'px)';
19675:         bx.drawImage(ctx.canvas,0,0); bx.filter='none';
19676:         blurD=bx.getImageData(0,0,w,h).data;
19677:       }catch(e){ blurD=null; }
19678:     }
19679:     // find incisal (top) and cervical (bottom) extent of the enamel band
19680:     let minY = h, maxY = 0;
19681:     for(let i = 0; i < emD.length; i += 4){
19682:       if(emD[i] > 64){
19683:         const py = ((i >> 2) / w) | 0;
19684:         if(py < minY) minY = py;
19685:         if(py > maxY) maxY = py;
19686:       }
19687:     }
19688:     if(minY >= maxY) return;
19689:     const enamelH = maxY - minY;
19690:     for(let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++){
19691:       const relY = (y - minY) / enamelH; // 0 = incisal edge, 1 = gingival
19692:       for(let x = 0; x < w; x++){
19693:         const qi = y * w + x;
19694:         const m = emD[qi << 2] / 255; // enamel mask weight at this pixel
19695:         if(m < 0.04) continue;
19696:         const p = qi << 2;
19697:         let r = d[p], g = d[p+1], b = d[p+2];
19698:         if(!smooth){
19699:           // ===== Naturalization (right side) =====
19700:           // ハロー効果 — incisal translucency: blue-grey shift in top 12% of enamel band
19701:           if(relY < 0.12){
19702:             const t = Math.pow(1 - relY / 0.12, 1.6);
19703:             const halo = t * amt * 0.20 * m;
19704:             const lum = (r + g + b) / 3;
19705:             r = clamp(r + (lum * 0.80 - r) * halo, 0, 255);
19706:             g = clamp(g + (lum * 0.90 - g) * halo, 0, 255);
19707:             b = clamp(b + (Math.min(255, lum * 1.06 + 14) - b) * halo, 0, 255);
19708:           }
19709:           // 周波条 — fine horizontal perikymata ridges every 4 px, concentrated near incisal
19710:           const periW = Math.max(0, 1 - relY * 2.2) * amt * 0.030 * m;
19711:           if(periW > 0.001){
19712:             const periMod = Math.sin((y % 4) * Math.PI * 0.5) * periW;
19713:             r = clamp(r + periMod * 65, 0, 255);
19714:             g = clamp(g + periMod * 65, 0, 255);
19715:             b = clamp(b + periMod * 65, 0, 255);
19716:           }
19717:           // マメロン — 3 developmental lobe brightness variations at incisal third
19718:           if(relY < 0.28){
19719:             const mamZ = Math.pow(1 - relY / 0.28, 1.3);
19720:             const lobeAmp = Math.cos(x / w * Math.PI * 6) * 0.5 + 0.5;
19721:             const mamS = lobeAmp * mamZ * amt * 0.050 * m;
19722:             const lum = (r + g + b) / 3;
19723:             r = clamp(r + (lum + 5 - r) * mamS, 0, 255);
19724:             g = clamp(g + (lum + 5 - g) * mamS, 0, 255);
19725:             b = clamp(b + (lum + 9 - b) * mamS, 0, 255);
19726:           }
19727:         } else {
19728:           // ===== Smooth (left side) — minimise surface texture / anatomy =====
19729:           if(blurD){
19730:             const k = amt * 0.92 * m;   // blend toward the blurred copy: evens out micro-texture
19731:             r += (blurD[p]   - r) * k;
19732:             g += (blurD[p+1] - g) * k;
19733:             b += (blurD[p+2] - b) * k;
19734:           }
19735:         }
19736:         d[p] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, r)) | 0; d[p+1] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, g)) | 0; d[p+2] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, b)) | 0;
19737:       }
19738:     }
19739:     ctx.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
19740:   }

19742:   // ── Sim Studio landmark-aware multi-zone ROI + distance-based soft matte ──────
19743:   // Maps treatment concept + active chief complaint cards → not just Support/Context
19744:   // *extent* but also the directional *shape* of the ROI (horizontal widening toward
19745:   // the commissures, vertical extension toward the gingiva or the incisal edge).
19746:   // This is what makes each card change the ROI's FORM, not only a magnitude value.
19747:   function cfSimROIConfig(concept, targets){
19748:     // radial extent multipliers — context defines the outermost falloff radius
19749:     let support=1.55, context=2.15;
19750:     // directional shape bias (neutral = 1.0 / 0.0)
19751:     let biasX=1.0;     // horizontal widening toward the mouth corners
19752:     let biasUp=0.0;    // upward (gingival) extension, as a fraction of ry
19753:     let biasDown=0.0;  // downward (incisal / lower-lip) extension, fraction of ry
19754:     // ---- treatment concept shapes the base ROI ----
19755:     if(concept==='prosthetic'){ support=1.75; context=2.35; biasUp=0.10; }        // target tooth unit + gingival emergence
19756:     else if(concept==='hybrid'){ support=2.00; context=2.85; biasX=1.14; biasUp=0.12; biasDown=0.10; } // widest multi-zone
19757:     else { support=1.60; context=2.20; biasX=1.18; biasDown=0.06; }               // ortho: arch / smile-line → widen toward corners

19769:   // Continuous distance-based soft matte (NO banding).  A multi-stop radial gradient
19770:   // encodes the Core→Support→Context edit contribution as a SMOOTH falloff from the
19771:   // ROI centre (the radial coordinate is the distance, so the decay is continuous —
19772:   // unlike stacked discrete-alpha ellipses which leave visible bands).  An anisotropic
19773:   // transform + directional bias give the ROI its per-card SHAPE; an optional feathered
19774:   // landmark polygon clips the matte to the real mouth contour (facial) so the result
19775:   // follows anatomy instead of a bare symmetric ellipse.
19776:   //   Core      → alpha ≈ 1.00  dental crowns / incisal / spaces / restoration
19777:   //   Inner Sup → alpha ≈ 0.70  papilla / gingival margin / inner lip
19778:   //   Outer Sup → alpha ≈ 0.40  gingiva / lip surface / commissure
19779:   //   Context   → alpha ≈ 0.20  perioral skin / sub-nasal / chin shadow → 0
19780:   function cfBuildSoftMatte(w, h, cx, cy, rx, ry, scales, featherPx, shapePoly){
19781:     const off=document.createElement('canvas'); off.width=w; off.height=h;
19782:     const ox=off.getContext('2d');
19783:     const biasX=scales.biasX||1.0;
19784:     const upPx=(scales.biasUp||0)*ry;     // gingival extension (pixels)
19785:     const downPx=(scales.biasDown||0)*ry; // incisal extension (pixels)
19786:     // Outermost extent = the context ring → the gradient's unit radius (=1).
19787:     const Rx=Math.max(2, rx*scales.context*biasX);
19788:     const Ry=Math.max(2, ry*scales.context);
19789:     // Vertical centre shift toward the card's anatomical target (gingiva ↑ / incisal ↓).
19790:     const cyShift=(downPx-upPx)*0.5;
19791:     // Core / support boundaries expressed as fractions of the context radius → gradient stops.
19792:     const coreFrac =Math.max(0.12, Math.min(0.55, scales.core/scales.context));
19793:     const supInFr  =Math.max(coreFrac+0.06, Math.min(0.74, (scales.support/scales.context)*0.74));
19794:     const supOutFr =Math.max(supInFr+0.06,  Math.min(0.90, scales.support/scales.context));
19795:     ox.save();
19796:     ox.translate(cx, cy+cyShift);
19797:     ox.scale(Rx, Ry);                       // unit circle → ROI ellipse (anisotropic + biased)
19798:     const g=ox.createRadialGradient(0,0,0, 0,0,1);
19799:     g.addColorStop(0,          'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
19800:     g.addColorStop(coreFrac,   'rgba(255,255,255,1)');     // Core plateau
19801:     g.addColorStop(supInFr,    'rgba(255,255,255,0.70)');  // Inner Support
19802:     g.addColorStop(supOutFr,   'rgba(255,255,255,0.40)');  // Outer Support
19803:     g.addColorStop(0.92,       'rgba(255,255,255,0.18)');  // Context
19804:     g.addColorStop(1,          'rgba(255,255,255,0)');      // continuous fade to zero
19805:     ox.fillStyle=g;
19806:     ox.beginPath(); ox.arc(0,0,1,0,Math.PI*2); ox.fill();
19807:     ox.restore();
19808:     // Light global feather to erase any gradient quantisation steps.
19809:     if(featherPx>0.5){
19810:       const fb=document.createElement('canvas'); fb.width=w; fb.height=h;
19811:       const fbx=fb.getContext('2d');
19812:       fbx.filter='blur('+Math.max(1,Math.round(featherPx*0.5))+'px)';
19813:       fbx.drawImage(off,0,0); fbx.filter='none';
19814:       ox.clearRect(0,0,w,h); ox.drawImage(fb,0,0);
19815:     }
19816:     // FACIAL: clip the radial matte to a generously-expanded, heavily-feathered lip
19817:     // polygon so the ROI follows the real mouth contour (structural, landmark-based)
19818:     // rather than a symmetric ellipse.  Both edges (gradient falloff ∧ polygon feather)
19819:     // are soft, so their intersection stays soft — no hard outline.

19651:   // Pixel-level Bio-Blend overlay for intraoral contraster shots. BIDIRECTIONAL:
19652:   //   bb > 0 => naturalization microstructure: マメロン / 周波条 / ハロー効果
19653:   //   bb < 0 => SMOOTH: minimise surface texture / anatomy, emphasise a smooth even surface
19654:   // ox = 2d context of the source image (used to build the enamel mask).
19655:   // ctx = output 2d context to draw effects onto.
19656:   // bb = signed bio-blend strength, -1..+1.
19657:   function applyIntraoralBioBlend(ctx, ox, w, h, bb){
19658:     if(Math.abs(bb) <= 0.01) return;
19659:     const smooth = bb < 0;
19660:     const amt = Math.abs(bb);   // 0..1
19661:     const em = enamelMaskCanvas(ox, w, h);
19662:     if(!em) return;
19663:     const emx = em.getContext('2d', {willReadFrequently: true});

19666:     const d = id.data;

19671:       try{

19678:     }
19679:     // find incisal (top) and cervical (bottom) extent of the enamel band
19680:     let minY = h, maxY = 0;

19682:       if(emD[i] > 64){
19683:         const py = ((i >> 2) / w) | 0;
19684:         if(py < minY) minY = py;
19685:         if(py > maxY) maxY = py;
19686:       }
19687:     }
19688:     if(minY >= maxY) return;
19689:     const enamelH = maxY - minY;
19690:     for(let y = minY; y <= maxY; y++){
19691:       const relY = (y - minY) / enamelH; // 0 = incisal edge, 1 = gingival
19692:       for(let x = 0; x < w; x++){
19693:         const qi = y * w + x;

19695:         if(m < 0.04) continue;
19696:         const p = qi << 2;

19698:         if(!smooth){
19699:           // ===== Naturalization (right side) =====
19700:           // ハロー効果 — incisal translucency: blue-grey shift in top 12% of enamel band
19701:           if(relY < 0.12){
19702:             const t = Math.pow(1 - relY / 0.12, 1.6);
19703:             const halo = t * amt * 0.20 * m;
19704:             const lum = (r + g + b) / 3;
19705:             r = clamp(r + (lum * 0.80 - r) * halo, 0, 255);
19706:             g = clamp(g + (lum * 0.90 - g) * halo, 0, 255);
19707:             b = clamp(b + (Math.min(255, lum * 1.06 + 14) - b) * halo, 0, 255);

19711:           if(periW > 0.001){

19713:             r = clamp(r + periMod * 65, 0, 255);
19714:             g = clamp(g + periMod * 65, 0, 255);
19715:             b = clamp(b + periMod * 65, 0, 255);
19716:           }
19717:           // マメロン — 3 developmental lobe brightness variations at incisal third
19718:           if(relY < 0.28){
19719:             const mamZ = Math.pow(1 - relY / 0.28, 1.3);

20146:   async function generateViaAI(source){
20147:     const epRaw=aiEndpoint(); if(!epRaw) return null;
20148:     // Token gate: 1回作成 = 2 tokens。失敗時は refund_generation_tokens で返却。
20149:     let _ledgerId=null;
20150:     if(typeof window.cfConsumeToken==='function'){
20151:       const _tk = await window.cfConsumeToken('generation');
20152:       if(_tk && _tk.ok===false){
20153:         if(_tk.reason==='insufficient' && typeof window.cfShowTokenEmpty==='function'){ window.cfShowTokenEmpty(); }
20154:         const _e=new Error(_tk.reason==='insufficient'?'トークンが不足しています':'トークンの確認に失敗しました');
20155:         _e.cfNoTokens=true; throw _e;
20156:       }
20157:       _ledgerId=(_tk&&_tk.ledgerId)||null;
20158:     }
20159:     try{
20160:       let ep=epRaw.replace(/\/+$/,''); if(!/\/simulate$/.test(ep)) ep+='/simulate';
20161:       const _payload=buildSimulationPayload(source);
20162:       const _cfImageEdge=(source&&source.intraoral)?1536:1280;
20163:       const _cfPrepStart=performance.now();
20164:       _payload.image=await cfPrepareGenerationImage(_payload.image,_cfImageEdge,0.84);
20165:       const _cfPayloadBytes=JSON.stringify(_payload).length;
20166:       const _cfRequestStart=performance.now();
20167:       const res=await fetchSimWithRetry(ep, JSON.stringify(_payload),1);
20168:       window.__caseflowLastRequestTiming={prepare_ms:Math.round(_cfRequestStart-_cfPrepStart),request_ms:Math.round(performance.now()-_cfRequestStart),payload_bytes:_cfPayloadBytes};
20169:       const j=await res.json();
20170:       if(j && j.error) throw new Error(String(j.error).slice(0,400));
20171:       const out=j.image || j.dataUrl || j.output || (Array.isArray(j.images)?j.images[0]:null) || null;
20172:       if(!out) throw new Error('画像が返りませんでした (no image in response)');
20173:       const kind=(typeof sourceKind==='function') ? sourceKind(source) : 'Image';
20174:       try{ return await Promise.race([finalizeAIImage(source.dataUrl, out, kind, {intraoral:!!(source&&source.intraoral), lips:!!(source&&source.lips)}),new Promise((_,rej)=>setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('画像仕上げ処理がタイムアウトしました')),5000))]); }
20175:       catch(e){ console.warn('finalize failed or timed out, using raw AI image', e); return out; }
20176:     }catch(genErr){
20177:       // 生成失敗 → トークン返却（失敗生成は原則消費なし）
20178:       if(_ledgerId!=null && typeof window.cfRefundGeneration==='function'){
20179:         try{ window.cfRefundGeneration(_ledgerId); }catch(e){ console.error('[CF Gate] refund call failed',e); }
20180:       }
20181:       if(typeof window.cfLogEvent==='function') window.cfLogEvent('generation_failed','visual-simulation',{ message:String((genErr&&genErr.message)||'').slice(0,120) });
20182:       throw genErr;
20183:     }
20184:   }

20190:   async function createSimulationImageV96(source, raw){
20191:     // Shade is BIDIRECTIONAL around the 50 centre: >50 whitens, <50 ages
20192:     // (aging = LOWER value + ADD chroma — a deeper, warmer, more saturated amber shade).
20193:     const shadeSigned = (clamp(raw.shade,0,100)-50)/50;   // -1 (max aging) .. +1 (max whitening)
20194:     const shadeWhiten = Math.max(0,  shadeSigned);          // 0..1
20195:     const shadeAge    = Math.max(0, -shadeSigned);          // 0..1
20196:     const shadeAct    = Math.abs(shadeSigned);              // 0..1 (either direction)
20197:     const P = {
20198:       shade:      shadeAct,
20199:       alignment:  clamp(raw.alignment,0,100)/100,
20200:       // Tooth Shape is bidirectional (tapering ↔ square); locally we can only smooth, so the
20201:       // tapering side drives mild surface smoothing and the square side does nothing here.
20202:       toothShape: Math.max(0,(50-clamp(raw.toothShape,0,100))/50),
20203:       scallop:    clamp(raw.scallop,0,100)/100,
20204:       smileFrame: clamp(raw.smileFrame,0,100)/100

20020:   async function fetchSimWithRetry(ep, body, maxAttempts){
20021:     maxAttempts=maxAttempts||1;
20022:     let lastErr=null;
20023:     for(let attempt=1; attempt<=maxAttempts; attempt++){
20024:       let ctrl=null, tid=null;
20025:       try{
20026:         ctrl=new AbortController();
20027:         window.__cfGenerationAbort=function(){ try{ ctrl.abort(); }catch(e){} };
20028:         tid=setTimeout(function(){ try{ ctrl.abort(); }catch(e){} },20000);
20029:         const res=await fetch(ep,{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:body,signal:ctrl.signal});
20030:         clearTimeout(tid); tid=null; window.__cfGenerationAbort=null;
20031:         if(res.ok) return res;
20032:         let t=''; try{ t=await res.text(); }catch(e){}
20033:         const err=new Error('HTTP '+res.status+' '+t.slice(0,400));
20034:         if(RETRY_STATUS[res.status] && attempt<maxAttempts) lastErr=err; else throw err;
20035:       }catch(e){
20036:         if(tid) clearTimeout(tid); window.__cfGenerationAbort=null;
20037:         if(e && e.name==='AbortError') e=new Error('生成処理がタイムアウトしました。通信状態を確認して再試行してください。');
20038:         if(/^HTTP \d/.test(e&&e.message||'') && !RETRY_STATUS[parseInt((e.message.match(/HTTP (\d+)/)||[])[1],10)]) throw e;
20039:         lastErr=e; if(attempt>=maxAttempts) break;
20040:       }
20041:       const wait=Math.pow(2,attempt-1)*900 + Math.floor(Math.random()*300);
20042:       try{ const q=document.querySelector('.cfWaitOverlay .cfWaitSub'); if(q) q.textContent='サーバー応答を待っています… 再試行 '+attempt+'/'+(maxAttempts-1); }catch(e){}
20043:       await sleep(wait);
20044:     }
20045:     throw lastErr || new Error('生成リクエストに失敗しました');
20046:   }

20058:     const isHybrid=(concept==='hybrid');
20059:     const isExtraction=isOrtho && align>=80;
20060:     // denoising_strength: controls how aggressively the AI departs from the source.
20061:     // Extraction cases need high values (0.85+) to achieve anterior retraction and
20062:     // arch shortening — previous 0.68/0.78 was insufficient for visible arch change.
20063:     // Hybrid mode uses an elevated value to allow arch reconstruction before
20064:     // surface refinement. Normal/prosthetic stays conservative.
20065:     let denoising_strength;
20066:     if(isExtraction){ denoising_strength=align>=90?0.90:0.86; }
20067:     else if(isHybrid){ denoising_strength=0.74; }
20068:     else { denoising_strength=0.48; }
20069:     // control_weight: relaxes ControlNet conditioning for extraction cases so the AI
20070:     // has enough freedom to reconstruct the anterior arch in a retracted position.
20071:     const control_weight=isExtraction?0.45:undefined;
20072:     // prompt_weights: passed to backends that support multi-priority or ControlNet
20073:     // weight scheduling (alignment phase first, prosthetic surface phase second).
20074:     const prompt_weights=isHybrid?{alignment:isExtraction?1.8:1.5,prosthetic:1.1,shade:1.0}:null;
20075:     // Clinician-confirmed bracket state drives inpainting mode and negative prompting.
20076:     // Source-aware: Macro/Facial uses macroHasBrackets, Micro/Focus uses hasBrackets.
20077:     const isFacialSrc=(typeof sourceKind==='function' ? sourceKind(source)==='Facial' : !!(source&&source.category==='facial'));
20078:     const hasBracketsFlag=isFacialSrc ? !!(source&&source.macroHasBrackets) : !!(source&&source.hasBrackets);
20079:     // Bracket removal needs more aggressive denoising to fully erase metal hardware
20080:     // and reconstruct underlying enamel — floor raised to 0.72.
20081:     if(hasBracketsFlag) denoising_strength=Math.max(denoising_strength,0.72);
20082:     // Facial source: the result is composited back ONLY inside the lip aperture (teeth/gingiva),
20083:     // so the AI may change the dentition strongly without any identity/skin risk. Raise the
20084:     // floor for facial ortho/hybrid so the smile correction is clearly visible (matches the
20085:     // "補正が弱い" feedback) — the face stays the patient's own pixels regardless.
20086:     // Facial floor: enough to clearly idealise the dentition, but NOT so high that the model
20087:     // regenerates a generic (often gummy) smile instead of editing this patient's teeth.
20088:     if(isFacialSrc && isOrtho && !isExtraction) denoising_strength=Math.max(denoising_strength, isHybrid?0.74:0.70);

20091:       prompt:buildClinicalPrompt(),
20092:       params:s,
20093:       concept:concept,
20094:       targets:v.targets,
20095:       intraoral:!!(source&&source.intraoral),
20096:       lips:!!(source&&source.lips),
20097:       denoising_strength:denoising_strength,
20098:       extraction_mode:isExtraction,
20099:       hybrid_mode:isHybrid,
20100:       has_brackets:hasBracketsFlag,
20101:       facial_source:isFacialSrc,
20102:       // Prosthetic + facial → backend should process the mouth with close-up (focus) restorative
20103:       // precision while the facial lip-mask blend preserves the surrounding face.
20104:       prosthetic_focus:(concept==='prosthetic' && isFacialSrc)

20106:     if(!hasBracketsFlag){

20108:       // Facial photos additionally guard against lip/smile distortion artefacts.
20109:       payload.negative_prompt=isFacialSrc
20110:         ? 'braces, brackets, wires, distorted lips, unnatural smile line, metallic dental appliances, orthodontic attachments, warped mouth, '
20111:           + 'different face, different person, age change, older appearance, younger appearance, adult face for child patient, '
20112:           + 'altered jaw, different chin shape, changed facial contour, reshaped nose, different ethnic features, '
20113:           + 'changed commissure angle, upturned corners, lifted mouth corners, changed lower face, facial reconstruction, '

05231:   });
05232:   return 0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b;

24483:   window.cfCapPrevImage=function(){
24484:     var ph=(window.state&&state.photos)||[];
24485:     var i=typeof state.v75ActiveIndex==='number'?state.v75ActiveIndex:0;
24486:     if(ph.length<2||i<=0){ toastFn('これ以上前に移動できません'); return; }
24487:     cfCapPushUndo();
24488:     var tmp=ph[i]; ph[i]=ph[i-1]; ph[i-1]=tmp;
24489:     state.v75ActiveIndex=i-1;
24490:     if(typeof window.caseflowV75Refresh==='function') window.caseflowV75Refresh();
24491:     else refresh();

24493:   window.cfCapNextImage=function(){
24494:     var ph=(window.state&&state.photos)||[];
24495:     var i=typeof state.v75ActiveIndex==='number'?state.v75ActiveIndex:0;
24496:     if(ph.length<2||i>=ph.length-1){ toastFn('これ以上後ろに移動できません'); return; }
24497:     cfCapPushUndo();
24498:     var tmp=ph[i]; ph[i]=ph[i+1]; ph[i+1]=tmp;
24499:     state.v75ActiveIndex=i+1;
24500:     if(typeof window.caseflowV75Refresh==='function') window.caseflowV75Refresh();
24501:     else refresh();
24502:   };
24503:   window.cfCapUndoImage=function(){
24504:     if(!window._cfCapUndoStack||!window._cfCapUndoStack.length){ toastFn('取り消す操作がありません'); return; }
24505:     try{
24506:       var saved=JSON.parse(window._cfCapUndoStack.pop());
24507:       if(window.state) state.photos=saved;
24508:       state.v75ActiveIndex=Math.min(state.v75ActiveIndex||0,Math.max(0,saved.length-1));
24509:       if(typeof window.caseflowV75Refresh==='function') window.caseflowV75Refresh();
24510:       if(typeof window.renderUpload==='function') window.renderUpload();
24511:       refresh();
24512:       toastFn('取り消しました');
24513:     }catch(e){ toastFn('取り消しに失敗しました'); }
24514:   };
24515:   window.cfCapDeleteImage=function(){
24516:     var ph=(window.state&&state.photos)||[];
24517:     var i=typeof state.v75ActiveIndex==='number'?state.v75ActiveIndex:0;
24518:     if(!ph[i]){ toastFn('削除する画像がありません'); return; }
24519:     var label=ph[i].label||ph[i].name||('Image '+(i+1));
24520:     if(!window.confirm('「'+label+'」を削除しますか？\nこの操作は取り消せます（Undoボタン）。')) return;
24521:     cfCapPushUndo();
24522:     ph.splice(i,1);
24523:     state.v75ActiveIndex=Math.min(i,Math.max(0,ph.length-1));
24524:     if(typeof window.caseflowV75Refresh==='function') window.caseflowV75Refresh();
24525:     if(typeof window.renderUpload==='function') window.renderUpload();
24526:     if(typeof window.renderSimulator==='function') window.renderSimulator();
24527:     refresh();
24528:     toastFn('画像を削除しました');

24615:   async function getLipInnerRing(img, w, h){
24616:     try{

24619:       if(!ok || !window.CaseFlowLocalML || !window.CaseFlowLocalML.faceLandmarker) return null;
24620:       var res = window.CaseFlowLocalML.faceLandmarker.detect(img);
24621:       if(!res || !res.faceLandmarks || !res.faceLandmarks.length) return null;
24622:       var L = res.faceLandmarks[0];
24623:       var ring = [78,191,80,81,82,13,312,311,310,415,308,324,318,402,317,14,87,178,88,95];
24624:       var pts = ring.map(function(i){ return L[i]; }).filter(Boolean).map(function(p){ return {x:p.x*w, y:p.y*h}; });
24625:       return pts.length>=10 ? pts : null;
24626:     }catch(e){ return null; }
24627:   }
